About.title: About
About.heroDesc: We believe that human resource management doesn't have to be complicated. Our mission is to empower businesses in Indonesia with modern, compliant, and easy-to-use HR technology.
About.visionDesc: HariKerja was born from the need for an HR system that truly understands the business landscape in Indonesia. From dynamic PPh 21 tax calculations to BPJS contribution integration, we build systems that ensure your company always complies with the latest regulations (such as TER 2024).
About.visionFeature1: Democratization of HR technology for MSMEs to Enterprise.
About.visionFeature4: Continuous innovation following Indonesian regulatory developments.
About.principle1Desc: Strict tenant data isolation ensures your employee information is safe and private.

About.principle3Desc: Our support team is ready to help you with a deep understanding of HR in Indonesia.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Can I change plans at any time?
faq.a1: Yes, you can upgrade your plan at any time. Costs will be prorated based on the remaining active period of your subscription.
faq.a2: We use advanced encryption and database isolation for each tenant. Your data will not be mixed with other companies' data.
faq.a3: Certainly. Our payroll system is always updated following the latest tax regulations in Indonesia, including the Average Effective Rate (TER) 2024 scheme.
faq.q4: How long is the grace period if I forget to pay?
faq.a4: We provide a 14-day grace period after the plan's validity expires before the system disables access to certain modules.
